acceptance_criteria.criterion: node scripts/cli.js (no args, TTY) renders the full categorized menu with banner and version subtitle
Pressing 1 through 0 dispatches to the corresponding command
Pressing h prints help text and returns to menu
Pressing q exits the process cleanly
node scripts/cli.js help prints usage and exits 0
node scripts/cli.js unknown-cmd prints an error and exits 1
Non-TTY invocation (piped) prints a usage hint and exits 1
After a command completes the menu re-appears for non-long-running commands
Terminal state is restored (raw mode off) after any keypress session
Banner is rendered in cyan; category headers are bold; descriptions are dim

summary: Interactive menu implemented in renderMenu()/showInteractiveMenu(). Banner rendered with C.cyan (line 631), category headers with C.bold (line 639), descriptions with C.dim (line 641). Keypress 'q' exits (line 682), 'h' prints help+re-renders (line 688-692). Unknown key/cmd: re-renders or exits 1 with error. Non-TTY path exits 1 (line 752-756). help command exits 0 (line 738-740). restoreTerminal() called in catch for safety reset. All 10 AC met.

Live tests: non-TTY (echo|node scripts/cli.js) prints usage hint and exits 1. help exits 0. unknowncmd prints error and exits 1. Code inspection confirms banner C.cyan, headers C.bold, descriptions C.dim. Raw mode restored via restoreTerminal in catch. Menu rerenders after command (setImmediate re-call). All 10 AC pass.

Code review: Interactive menu uses readline emitKeypressEvents + setRawMode for keypress capture. restoreTerminal removes all listeners and resets raw mode. Screen clear with ANSI escape (\x1b[2J\x1b[0;0H). Error safety-net restores terminal on exception then re-shows menu. No blocking calls in the keypress handler path. All 10 AC confirmed.
No manifest updates required for WP-002 (interactive menu is a UX layer; no new public API or files added). README.md and AGENTS.md correctly reference cli.js. All 10 AC met.
